pr_body:
The presence of follower data streams would cause autoscaling capacity
calculation to fail.

Closes #82857
pr_title: Fix autoscaling of follower data streams
pr_comment: Hi @henningandersen, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Maybe I'm missing something, but why would rolling over only the follower data stream help here? Should data streams that are being replicated be skipped during the auto scale rollover instead?

Forcefully rolling over a replicated data stream means that the data stream on the follower side would get a backing index that will never exist on the leader side. This index will not never be used. Locally it can't accept writes and on the leader side writes will be resolved to the write index know by the leader data stream. When the leader data stream rolls over, it will create a new backing index as write index, that is different than the backing index created by the rollover triggered from auto scaling.
